A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material. Renamed components and experiments moved between the main text and appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original CIFAR-LT experiments, cross-architecture evaluations, ablations, and supplementary Tiny-ImageNet-LT and long-tailed test-set results.

after.justification: v2 retains original experimental results and adds ImageNet-LT comparisons and DD-Ranking evaluation results.

M1.justification: Weight Mismatch Avoidance becomes Distribution-agnostic Matching, and Adaptive Decoupled Matching becomes Expert Decoupling. The reweighted student loss, classifier-generated soft labels, and joint backbone/classifier trajectory matching remain unchanged.

E1.justification: v2 adds larger-scale ImageNet-LT classification experiments beyond the retained CIFAR-10-LT, CIFAR-100-LT, and Tiny-ImageNet-LT coverage. Tiny-ImageNet-LT was already evaluated in v1 Appendix B and is not a newly added dataset.

E2.justification: v2 adds Minimax to the CIFAR-10-LT comparison and K-Center Greedy, Graph-Cut, and DREAM to the Tiny-ImageNet-LT comparison. Its new ImageNet-LT comparison also introduces G-VBSM, TESLA, and SRe2L, substantially broadening the evaluated comparator set.

E3.justification: Existing training budgets are retained, while v2 adds ImageNet-LT settings with imbalance factors 5/10 and IPC 10/20, plus DD-Ranking metrics. Tiny-ImageNet-LT's second reported imbalance factor changes from 50 in v1 Table 4 to 20 in v2 Table 2 despite retained scores; the PDFs do not establish whether those experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 Section 7.2 adds a DD-Ranking analysis intended to assess distilled-data informativeness with reduced influence from knowledge distillation and augmentation. Existing component, matching-strategy, distribution, and long-tailed test-set analyses remain; the hyperparameter study was already in v1 Appendix C.1.

E5.justification: Both versions report plus/minus values in benchmark tables and point estimates in many analyses. Neither specifies repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures, and v2 introduces no new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 adds ImageNet-LT, additional baseline, and DD-Ranking results. For example, Table 3 newly reports 20.8±0.2 for the proposed method versus 7.4±0.1 for DATM at imbalance factor 5 and IPC 10. Retained CIFAR and cross-architecture table values are unchanged, but Figure 6e appears to reverse the 55.5/57.9 hyperparameter-result assignments from v1 Table 5.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives and reasoning remain unchanged. v1 Equation 4 is split into v2 Equations 4–5, and the joint matching loss moves from Equation 5 to Equation 6 without mathematical revision. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: Both versions claim the first effective approach to long-tailed dataset distillation, identify the same two failure mechanisms, and propose the same two-component solution. The expanded experimental coverage supplies additional support without redefining these core contributions.

C2.justification: v2 interprets DD-Ranking as evidence of distilled-data informativeness and discusses memory constraints encountered in ImageNet-scale comparisons. It removes v1 Section 6's specific discussion of dual-expert computational overhead and half-precision mitigation, while retaining the computational-cost comparison.

D1.justification: v2 adds a prospective code-release address and identifies the depth-4 ConvNet and Tesla code base used for ImageNet-LT. Existing expert-training budgets, evaluation epochs, MaxNorm constraint, hardware disclosure, and CIFAR hyperparameter settings are retained, largely through relocation.

R1.justification: v2 adds generative dataset distillation to its related-work taxonomy, discusses Tesla's memory efficiency, and cites additional comparators and DD-Ranking. These extend the context while preserving the original positioning around the previously neglected long-tailed distillation problem.

P1.justification: v2 broadly revises the abstract, introduction, method explanations, and experimental narrative, standardizes component names, and updates author information. It also substantially reorganizes material: training settings move to the supplement, Tiny-ImageNet results and hyperparameter analyses enter the main text, and the limitations section is removed.

P2.justification: The document changes from single-column to two-column layout, splits v1 Figure 1, and reorganizes benchmark tables. It converts the hyperparameter table into Figure 6e, merges sensitivity tables, adds ImageNet-LT and DD-Ranking displays, and removes the full synthetic-dataset image mosaic.

improvement.justification: ImageNet-LT comparisons and broader baselines strengthen scalability evidence beyond v1's existing CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet validation, while DD-Ranking adds a useful check of distilled-data informativeness. These provide a limited net improvement. Unexplained Tiny-ImageNet imbalance-factor relabelling, the apparent hyperparameter-result swap, and removal of the explicit compute-limitation discussion temper the gains.
